summary: Prologis, Inc. and its Operating Partnership filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 30, 2026, establishing an at-the-market equity distribution program for up to $5.0 billion aggregate offering price of common stock, $0.01 par value, listed on the NYSE as PLD. The last reported sale price was $128.02 on October 29, 2026. Sales may be made through 26 named managers as agents or principals, in negotiated, block, privately negotiated or Rule 415 at-the-market transactions, and may include separate forward sale agreements with named forward purchasers, whose affiliates would borrow and sell shares to hedge. No proceeds accrue from borrowed-share sales. This is a routine shelf takedown vehicle, not a special situation; watch for dilution and forward-settlement overhang.
